name: Michael Kriegel
current_role: Co-founder, Quantum Systems (Gilching, Germany) — current title not confirmed
profile: Dr. Michael Kriegel met Florian Seibel at the Bundeswehr University Munich and co-founded drone maker Quantum Systems with Seibel, Tobias Kloss and Armin Busse in January 2015. The company builds eVTOL fixed-wing reconnaissance drones (Trinity, Vector) widely used in Ukraine, has grown past 1,000 staff and is valued in the billions.
interesting_fact: Quantum Systems' Vector drones were first sold to Ukraine in April 2022 for reconnaissance; by Aug 2024 about 288 had been delivered, and the Bundeswehr bought units for its own stocks.
deep_cut_fact: Together with Seibel he filed a 2012 German patent (DE102012104783) for the precursor of the company's first production drone — three years before Quantum Systems was incorporated. Its first product, the 'Tron' eVTOL, carried a 2 kg payload.
notes: Very low public profile; no personal channels found. Quantum Systems site is behind Cloudflare; press contact should be taken from its press page. Web-search budget ran out during this lane, so research was limited to directly fetched pages.

name: Jonathan Chan
current_role: Co-founder and Head of Partnerships, RedotPay (Hong Kong)
profile: Co-founded Hong Kong stablecoin-payments firm RedotPay with CEO Michael Gao in April 2023 and leads its partnerships. RedotPay offers crypto-funded payment cards, wallets and global payouts in 100+ markets, has 5M+ users, became a unicorn in 2025 and raised a $107M Series B at ~$2B valuation.
interesting_fact: RedotPay processes roughly $10B in annualised payment volume within about two years of launch, with backers including Coinbase Ventures, Galaxy, Vertex and Lightspeed.
deep_cut_fact: Speaking on a TON Foundation panel at TON Day in Hong Kong (April 2025) about RedotPay using TON for card top-ups and bill payments, he said 'financial freedom is not a privilege, but a standard.'
notes: Regular conference speaker (BUIDL Asia, TON Day, Money20/20 Asia) — conference circuit is a natural route. Company is in IPO preparation.

name: Jay Prakash Gupta
profile: Co-founded Dhan, the Mumbai-based stock-trading and investing app run by Raise Financial Services, in 2021 with Pravin Jadhav and Alok Pandey. Dhan targets active traders; it reported FY25 revenue of about Rs 904.5 crore (up ~138% YoY) and has raised ~$142M, its latest round in Oct 2025 valuing it at unicorn level.
interesting_fact: Dhan's revenue grew about 138% in a single year, from Rs 380.2 crore in FY24 to Rs 904.5 crore in FY25.
notes: Low personal profile; Pravin Jadhav is the public face of Dhan. No press email published on dhan.co (only support/grievance addresses such as help@dhan.co). Web-search budget ran out during this lane, so background research was limited.

name: Glenn Case
current_role: Co-founder of Hermeus (formerly Chief Technologist/CTO); current role unclear
profile: Propulsion engineer and one of four Generation Orbit veterans (USAF X-60A hypersonic program) who founded Hermeus in Atlanta in Nov 2018. He served as Hermeus's Chief Technologist; the company now builds uncrewed supersonic Quarterhorse aircraft for defense, became a unicorn in April 2026 and reached supersonic flight 364 days after its first flight.
interesting_fact: Hermeus says it is the fastest company in aviation history to go from founding to supersonic flight, and built the world's first private unmanned supersonic jet.
deep_cut_fact: He and his co-founders all learned startup-building at Generation Orbit under former Georgia Tech professor John Olds, and pitched Hermeus from kitchen tables and coffee shops, with no office until May 2019.
notes: No longer on Hermeus's current leadership page (Steve Furger is CTO), so he may have stepped back; his former Hermeus bio page (hermeus.com/glenn-case) is offline. Third-party sources say he was earlier a propulsion engineer at Blue Origin (unverified from a primary source).
